name: Trio of Terror

tenures.role: stable — an unresolved recruitment storyline at Carnacage 99; membership unknown
tenures.source: the fed's own served Carnacage III recap, part 11 — the closing recap and the Carnacage structure match itself (promotions/uga/archive/carnacage-11.html)

caption: A stable Jago Ripley tried to recruit Larry Gionet into at Carnacage 99, on offer of a tag-team spot if he and The Beast could first beat Street Punk and Joe Snow — an unresolved storyline the held record leaves open.
notes: The fed's own recap text is itself ambiguous about current membership: Gionet declines outright, then counter-proposes that Ripley and The Beast could earn a tag-team spot in the group by beating Street Punk and Joe Snow, implying (without stating outright) that Punk and Snow may already hold that spot.
